main_text.p: nus: Hæc ille: Interea nos prodigiosum Transsubstantiationis dogma quod vnum, tot in se absurdos errores continet, quot momenta temporis ab eius prima efformatione (id est a Concilio Lateranensi) ad hanc vsque horam intercesserunt, vt insomnium plane diabolicum, execrabimur.Antea enim libera erat cuique sua hac de re sententia. Tonst. de verit. corp. & sang. Idem. Scot. & Biel. vt citantur a Suarez. Scot. in 4. d. 11. q. 2. Dicendum quod Ecclesia declarauit ipsum intellectum esse de veritate fidei in illo symbolo edito sub Innoc. 3. in Concil. Lateranensi.

Vt huiusce mundi fit idem Christi corpus, quod tamen interea totum in coelis est; Vt interim corpus Christi in minimâ quadam plaga mundi ita delitescat, membra vt se non penetrent, sed distinctâ, et in-ter se dispositia sint habeantq; humanam

page.notes: The right-hand margin note is partly obscured; its readings are approximate. The lower text block is faded show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed beyond the legible opening lines, which are doubtful. The text "Vt huiusce... humanam" is partly illegible and may contain errors.
